front.title: Recommendations for Post-Quantum Signature Algorithms in TLS 1.3

abstract.t: With over 30 distinct post-quantum and hybrid/composite signature algorithm parameters proposed or registered for TLS 1.3 [RFC9847] [IANA-TLS] [I-D.ietf-tls-composite-mldsa], implementations face increasing complexity and deployment overhead. This document provides curated guidance to recommend a manageable subset of post- quantum signature schemes for standard TLS 1.3 deployments.
